verdict.rationale: Bento is an email automation platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back workflows is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions workflow version history, change review or diffs, or rollback. The closest items are the claim that you can "check every branch before it runs" (a pre-run preview, not change review or versioning) and the option to keep a separate testing Site (a user-side arrangement); neither counts toward this story.
